## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:

- `disks` (List of Object, Required) Attached disks.
  - `size_gb` (Number, Required) Disk size in GB.

    Must be a multiple of 10.
  - `encrypted` (Boolean, Optional) Encrypt the disk.
- `name` (String, Required) Server name.
- `network_id` (String, Required) ID of the network to attach the server to.
- `rule` (Block List, Required, Min: 1) Firewall rule.
  - `port` (Number, Required) Port.
  - `protocol` (String, Optional) Valid values are `tcp` and `udp`.
  - `source` (Block Set, Optional, Max: 5)
    - `cidr` (String, Required) Source CIDR.
- `label` (Block Map, Optional)
  - `value` (String, Required)
- `legacy_mode` (Boolean, Optional, Deprecated) Deprecated. Use `settings` instead.
- `password` (String, Optional, Sensitive) Administrator password.
- `settings` (Object, Optional) Advanced settings.
  - `backup` (Object, Optional) Backup policy.
    - `retention_days` (Number, Optional) Days to keep backups.
    - `schedule` (Object, Optional) See [nested schema](#nested--settings--backup--schedule).
- `size` (String, Optional) Server size. One of `small`, `medium`, `large`. Defaults to `small`.
- `tags` (Map of String, Optional) Tags applied to the server.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional)
  - `create` (String, Optional) Timeout for creation, e.g. `30m`.
  - `delete` (String, Optional)

## Attribute Reference

In addition to the arguments above, the following attributes are exported:

- `id` (String) Server identifier.
- `status` (Object) Runtime status.
  - `ip_address` (String)
  - `state` (String) Current state.

<a id="nested--settings--backup--schedule"></a>
### Nested schema for `settings.backup.schedule`

- `cron` (String, Required) Cron expression.
- `timezone` (String, Optional)
